tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background, the darkroom. Holds navigation and the workspace.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows. The default surface for content.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surface: dialogs, popovers, hover on cards and rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed surface: inputs, code and provenance blocks, progress bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders, structural only. Not for controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, model names, key figures. On every surface token and on accent-deep.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and table content on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on every surface token (at least 5.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled elements, decorative timecodes. Never for text people need to read; use ink-muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Dark violet, the reference colour. Fill for primary buttons and active selection, always with on-accent on top. Not for text or lines on dark surfaces (2.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills, with on-accent on top.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Selected card, active navigation row, background of Private tags. Text on it: ink-strong or accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as text: links, active tabs, focused values. On every surface token and on accent-deep.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Violet as a mark: progress bars, borders of selected cards, icons. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: safelight
tokens.usage: Darkroom safelight. Fill for anything that needs a human decision: cost approval, biometric data, amber status. on-safelight on top.

tokens.name: safelight-ink
tokens.usage: Safelight as text and icon on surface tokens and safelight-deep.

tokens.name: safelight-deep
tokens.usage: Background of approval banners and Biometric tags.

tokens.name: on-safelight
tokens.usage: Text on safelight fills.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status green: model runs, job done, host reachable. Deliberately cyan so it stays distinct from status-fail with red-green colour blindness. Always paired with a word or shape.

tokens.name: status-slow
tokens.usage: Status amber: runs only with offloading or slowly. Alias of safelight, because amber always means: take a closer look.

tokens.name: status-fail
tokens.usage: Status red: does not run, job failed, host gone. As text on surface tokens and status-fail-deep.

tokens.name: status-fail-deep
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and error banners.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. At least 6:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Once per view: setup steps, empty states. Not in dense views.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, section heads in panels, model names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Runs with offloading to system RAM.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons, tabs, table headers. Sentence case, no all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under cards, help text under fields.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: VRAM, quantization, seeds, parameters. Anything people copy or compare.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: Key figures in cards: ETA, seconds per step, peak VRAM.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Hashes, job IDs, paths. Truncated with a middle ellipsis, full value in the tooltip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, between tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gap between buttons, row gap in value lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of table rows and compact cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and panels, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Workspace margin, space above view titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, checkboxes, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, preview areas.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, progress bars, counters.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: dialogs, popovers, menus. Cards get no shadow; depth comes from the surface steps.
